Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original professional TD letter-monogram logo for ToolDawn, an international AI productivity tools platform. User explicitly wants the logo based on ONLY the letters T and D (uppercase or lowercase as directed). Letter recognition is the main priority: viewers should read TD, not an unrelated abstract emblem. Design custom letterforms, not typed stock initials. Explore ligature, shared strokes and precise negative space.
Layout: square 1024x1024, clean white background. Large isolated TD monogram centered in upper area near y300, roughly 300px wide. Exact brand wordmark "ToolDawn" centered below at y560, professionally drawn contemporary sans with optical kerning. Bottom quarter is a very pale tint of the concept color, containing the SAME monogram at small size to the left of exact "ToolDawn" wordmark. Same geometry at both sizes. Plenty of whitespace. No text besides the monogram letters and ToolDawn, no numbers, captions, watermark or slogan.
Artwork: crisp flat vector-like raster, two colors maximum for monogram, sharp deliberate contours, no gradients, no 3D, no texture, no shadow. Recognizable at 24px. No sun, bird, leaf, gear, wrench, mountain, cube, sparkle or decorative illustration. Avoid recognizable existing brand monograms. No dark background panel. Use this specific concept palette instead of default teal.
Specific direction: Uppercase T and D share a single strong vertical stem: T crossbar extends left, D bowl extends right. Both letters immediately recognizable. Precise bold geometric monogram, balanced near-square silhouette. Cobalt #3159E8 and sky blue #69C7F2.
